format: JavaScript (Node.js modules in ES module syntax, .mjs extension)
description: This script automates interaction with GitHub security advisories via the GitHub CLI, enabling creation and updating of security advisories for a project, specifically targeting npm ecosystem packages. It parses command-line arguments, constructs API requests, and outputs the updated advisory information.
